title: 透明容器里有一个微型的3D世界
prompt: A giant [transparent or glossy] [object/container] with a miniature 3D diorama inside it, depicting [a symbolic or narrative scene], studio-lit with soft shadows, placed on a neutral matte surface. Emphasize visual contrast between the scale of the capsule and the detail within. Highlight texture, light refraction, and emotional tone (e.g., surreal, poetic, or sci-fi).
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 打造未来科幻风格的透明容器微型3D世界，细腻展现光影折射与纹理细节，适合概念艺术与沉浸式叙事场景。
